preconditions.description: S1 and S2 must have equal length.
Length of S1 and S2 must not exceed 31.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S1) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S2)
preconditions.description: S1 and S2 consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (S1 == S2 or any((len(S1) > 0) and (all(S1[i] == S2[j] for i, j in zip(range(k), range(k + l))) and all(S1[i] == S2[j] for i, j in zip(range(k + l), range(k))) and isScramble(S1[:k], S2[k:k + l]) and isScramble(S1[k + l:], S2[:k])) or (all(S1[i] == S2[j] for i, j in zip(range(k), range(k + l))) and all(S1[i] == S2[j] for i, j in zip(range(k + l), range(k))) and isScramble(S1[:k], S2[k + l:]) and isScramble(S1[k + l:], S2[:k])) for k in range(1, len(S1)) for l in range(1, len(S1) - k)))
postconditions.description: Return True if S2 is a scrambled form of S1, meaning S2 can be obtained by recursively partitioning S1 into two non-empty substrings and swapping their children in the binary tree representation, or if S1 and S2 are identical.
